due_when.clears_when: A session that pushes BOTH .github/pr-automerge-requests/<slug>.txt and automation/pr-requests/<name>.json ends up with a PR carrying the pr-opener request's TITLE and BODY. Any of: (a) claude-pr-automerge.yml defers to a pending pr-request for the same head branch; (b) pr-opener.yml, on finding the PR already exists, EDITS its title and body instead of writing `FAILED:` and stopping; or (c) the two relays are documented as mutually exclusive with a stated ordering, and CLAUDE.md's relay section says which to use when both would apply. ⚠️ OBSERVE IT: not proven by a green workflow run — it needs one PR opened via this exact double-push whose final title is the requested one, not the head commit's subject.
